name: envy
author: Rick Hopkins <support@melodic.dev>
description: A clean container manager with automatic *.envy URLs and trusted local HTTPS for your services.

scripts.icons: node scripts/build-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-tray-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-dmg-background.mjs
scripts.prepackage: npm run build && npm run icons
scripts.package:dist: npm run build && npm run icons && ENVY_NOTARIZE=1 electron-builder --mac --win
scripts.package:all: npm run build && npm run icons && ENVY_NOTARIZE=1 electron-builder -mwl
scripts.package:win:test: npm run build && npm run icons && SKIP_WIN_SIGN=1 electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.release: node scripts/bump-version.mjs && node scripts/sync-web-version.mjs && npm run package:all && node scripts/release.mjs
